url.title: E-Commerce App
url.knownGap: No route guard — unauthenticated users who navigate directly to /orders are NOT redirected to /login; the frontend renders an empty order list instead.

orderCard.description: One card per order — confirmed from live app 2026-07-26
orderCard.orderIdAndDate: ORD-XXXXXX DD Month YYYY — e.g. 'ORD-793662 26 July 2026' (order number is 6 digits)

itemRow.productImage: img with product name as alt text

orderCard.totalPaidLabel: 'Total paid: LKR X.XX' — e.g. 'Total paid: LKR 50.00'

emptyState.description: Shown when user has no orders — structure from AC5, not confirmed via live app inspection
emptyState.message: 'You haven\'t placed any orders. Start shopping!'

unauthenticatedBehaviour.behaviour: Page renders at /orders with no redirect to /login. When auth token is absent the GET /api/orders call returns 401 and no order cards are displayed — the frontend silently shows an empty state. See knownGap.
